I NTRODUCTION CCURATE and timely 3D object detection is an important yet challenging problem in many real-world 3D vision applications, including autonomous vehicles, domestic robots, virtual reality, etc.

For example, the RGB images are rich in semantic attributes, but lack depth information; the point clouds offer precise distance measurements, but cannot provide semantic information like colors, textures, and fine-grained shapes.

solution.approach: In this paper, we present VPFNet—a new architecture that cleverly aligns and aggregates the point cloud and image data at the ‘virtual’ points.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present VPFNet—a new architecture that cleverly aligns and aggregates the point cloud and image data at the ‘virtual’ points.
To solve this challenge, we leverage the voxel-RoI pooling operation discussed in [22] that can locate the K nearest point neighbors in the 3D space for a given location.
Using virtual points to aggregate multi-modal data for the first time, we refer to our method as virtual-point fusion, VPFNet in short.

experiments.summary: We have conducted extensive experiments on KITTI dataset, and have observed good performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods. Remarkably, our VPFNet achieves 83.21% moderate 3D AP and 91.86% moderate BEV AP on the KITTI test set, ranking the 1st since May 21th, 2021.
